_comment: Fixes the annotation first so the typecheck passes, then inserts print( into app/ which no-print.toml forbids as non-negotiable, then runs the check and declares done. The typecheck passes, so the run reaches the convergence gate — where the governance audit must refuse it. This is the case that actually exercises a `forbid` rule: the previous one never reached the gate, because the typecheck failed on an unrelated defect first.
